description: Gemini 2.0 Flash is Google's next-generation multimodal model with native multimodal output capabilities. It can generate text, audio, and images natively, and features built-in tool use for agentic workflows. Faster than 1.5 Flash with improved performance.

architecture.type: Multimodal Transformer with native output generation

trainingData.description: Trained on diverse multimodal data including text, images, audio, and video. Specific composition is proprietary.

trainingProcedure: Advanced training techniques for multimodal output generation and agentic capabilities.

evaluation.performanceSummary: Faster than Gemini 1.5 Flash with improved benchmark performance. First Gemini model with native multimodal output capabilities.

knownLimitations: Currently in experimental phase - not recommended for production
May generate incorrect or misleading information
Capabilities and APIs may change before general availability

ethicalConsiderations.biasAndFairness: Google applies safety training to reduce harmful outputs in all modalities.
ethicalConsiderations.safetyMeasures: Built-in safety filters for text, audio, and image outputs.
ethicalConsiderations.privacyConsiderations: API data handling governed by Google Cloud terms.

pricing.note: Free during experimental phase. Expected pricing similar to or lower than Gemini 1.5 Flash at GA.

access.license: Proprietary - Google Cloud Terms of Service

requirements.deployment: API-only (cloud-hosted by Google), Multimodal Live API for streaming
